answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof of independent hosting: each identity must keep a distinct, long-lived endpoint with its own autonomous system, TLS certificate history, and uptime record, like a summit station above a nebula of lookalikes. Live probes compare fingerprints, so clones behind one cloud account share one ASN and echo the same certificate, collapsing to one identity. A farm must rent separate hosting and uptime for every fake, while one honest agent proves the endpoint it already runs, once.
